title: plan-preflight hardening: gitignore cam-plan-out logs + emit plan-preflight-failed event (subsume CAM-159)
description: Guarda-chuva de robustez do plan pre-flight, subsumindo CAM-159. Duas correcoes vistas dogfoodando CAM-121 (um cam plan haltou silencioso). (1) GITIGNORE: runPlanPhase escreve .claude/cam-plan-out-{planner,auditor}-<uuid>.log (pipe-pane do stdout do worker-pane); ship --finalize nao os git-rm; o .gitignore cobre .cam-worker-out-*.log mas NAO cam-plan-out-*. Efeito: git status --porcelain nao-vazio -> runPlanPreflight step clean-tree falha -> proximo cam plan halta sem spawnar planner. FIX: adicionar .claude/cam-plan-out-*.log ao .gitignore (espelhar .cam-worker-out-*.log, CAM-68). (2) OBSERVABILIDADE (ex-CAM-159): quando preflightFn retorna {ok:false,step,detail} dentro de runPlanPhase (plan-runner.ts:519), nenhum evento e emitido em cam-worker-events.jsonl; o operador nao distingue 'preflight barrou' de 'nada aconteceu'. FIX: emitir kind:'plan-preflight-failed' detail:{step,detail} via o logEvent ja presente, na paridade com sidecar-exit/spawn-resolution; estender a union WorkerEventKind (fechada). runPlanPreflight e funcao pura: nao emitir de dentro dela. P2.
